purpose: Normal-entry installed Wallet acceptance; source tests and Metro exports are prerequisites, not replacements.

devicePrerequisites.macOS: Human unlocks the Mac normally; never synthesize focused or unlocked key authority.
devicePrerequisites.originalAndroid: Human unlocks the original PIN normally; preserve all existing accounts and unknown outboxes.
devicePrerequisites.isolatedQA: Explicit separate empty profile; no original keys, no funds, no user credentials in receipts.

steps: Open the official installed Wallet with an explicitly isolated empty profile
Confirm no invented account or balance
Open the password/onboarding dialog; human completes credential entry
proof: public account count zero before creation

steps: Record current installed version, signing identity and public account list
Install the official final artifact through normal upgrade
Cold reopen without resetting storage
proof: no downgrade or alternate signing identity

steps: Create or select two normal QA accounts
Select A, then B, then A
Reject or cancel any pending approval before changing its account
proof: selected account visible and matches public main-process status
switch cancels signing, scanning and stale UI results

steps: Open Send while locked
Cancel the real unlock dialog
Retry through the normal dialog with human credential input
Open a draft or approval
Background or leave the real window
Return through normal unlock
proof: late authorization cannot sign or dispatch

steps: View a recorded account with ready balance
Use the visible Refresh action
Switch account or background while a read is pending
Retry an unavailable read
proof: faucet completion returns to refreshed balance

steps: Open Receive on the selected account
Scan its code with the real counterparty Wallet
Switch account and reopen Receive
proof: QR binds the selected native ynx1 address

steps: Open the real camera from Scan
Approve camera only through the normal OS prompt
Scan valid receiving, invalid-network and arbitrary-URL codes
Cancel, background and switch account during scanning
proof: late scan cannot route to another account
large text and small-screen cancel remain reachable

steps: Scan the real app WalletConnect v2 code
Review original app, selected account and exact permissions
Explicitly connect and return to the initiating app
proof: Pair failure and retry preserve original event identity

steps: Enter a supported whole-YNXT amount
Review recipient, amount and exact fee
Cancel once
Approve once with real key protection
proof: no new nonce or signature after unknown result

steps: Observe a retained original unknown transfer
Close and cold reopen Wallet
Check the exact original hash
Explicitly retry only the original signed bytes when permitted
proof: original account, origin, amount, nonce and bytes retained
verified local durability is not consensus finality

steps: Open completed local transfer or Pay receipt history
Read older pages
Switch account during a pending page
Cold reopen
proof: no replayable raw bytes exposed to Desktop renderer

steps: Resolve the original signed invoice with operator-pinned merchant policy
Verify the correct account-bound Pay session and original audience
Explicitly review and protect native signing
Broadcast original transaction
Settle and recover using original hash and idempotency key
Read back bound invoice and receipt
proof: V1 and V2 grants not widened or confused
no double payment after lost ACK

steps: Look up an actual original BFT contract
Review its validated pinned artifact
Select a supported read-only ABI method
Compare original address/calldata result
Use legacy mode only for an explicitly legacy local node
proof: no silent legacy fallback or full-EVM claim

steps: Open existing backup/recovery entry
Human performs normal backup credential entry or recovery confirmation
Restore only the matching existing account on the designated QA profile
proof: other accounts and unknown journals preserved
backup and credentials not included in receipt

steps: Use the actually configured Relay
Observe a real disconnection
Retry explicitly and return to the app
Lock and cold reopen
proof: actual transport state rather than SDK-ready inference
